title: Asking for directions and addressing strangers

text: Start with Entschuldigung or Entschuldigen Sie bitte and use Sie with a passer-by. People give clear, exact directions and often tell you how many minutes it takes on foot. They may count streets: die zweite Straße links.
You will often hear distances in metres and kilometres (300 Meter, zwei Kilometer). A phone map works nearly everywhere, but most people are happy to help, and a short Danke schön is enough thanks.
